name: Akira
speaker: entity:akira
lines: Another one..? You've got to be kidding me.
Well, either way it seems you know your place.
A nosy one eh? I'm on duty right now making sure no [depths](location:the_depths) creatures or otherwise unwanted parties wander into this area before the research platoon makes it over.

Is there something surprising about that or are you just uneducated..? We're currently in the [Depths](location:the_depths), we [Divers](faction:the_divers) blow boatloads of [Authority](faction:the_central_authority) funding on expeditions down here.

Oh you mean those mudskippers from [the Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union) just now? Calling them 'people' is somewhat of a stretch. Anyone who crosses me is an ally of the Depths for all I care. My judgment is absolute.
If it means you'll leave me to my reading, I'll tell you. I'm Akira, rank Black Diver, in charge of research site pre-clearing and new recruit field training.
As I said, I'm quite busy right now, and would love to continue reading this book. Make it to [Castle Light](location:castle_light) in one piece and we'll see about your recruitment there.

Oh, right.. You're serious, huh? I don't know what part of a diver's work you're interested in, but if you're resourceful enough to get through the life field protecting this place, you're smart enough to know that you're walking to your grave, surely.

That's right. I've been a diver close to ten years now. Every year, I meet hundreds of new ambitious recruits anxious to begin their research and so on, and by the end of the year only one or two will remain.
Only one or two. If you seriously want to join an organization with a 98% annual casualty rate, then by all means, you're welcome to. I can't promise you that it'll go well for you, though.
